description: Add a new note to a brain; the server resolves storage from the brain record (BlackOps for DB-backed brains, a GitHub commit for vault-backed ones). Use this whenever the user says "update the brain", "add this to the brain", or "log this in the brain". Call list_brains first for the brain_id if you do not have it; create_brain makes a new brain. A DB-backed brain recompiles immediately; a vault-backed one on its next compile. Use post_notes_write (with brain_id) only for control over the filename or path. A brain's sanitize rules may hold a write: follow details.sanitize_hold.

agent.description: Your name, on every write: Duet/<channel name> or Grok Bot/<bot name>.

allow_secrets.description: Set true to store content that looks like a credential (API key, token, private key), which is otherwise refused with SECRET_DETECTED. Only when the user asked to store that exact value.

markdown_content.description: Markdown content for the new note to add to the brain

note_filename.description: Filename without .md. Defaults from section_title or the date.

sanitize_answer.description: Only after a SANITIZE_ANSWER_REQUIRED hold: repeat the same call with { hold_id, decisions: { <rule>: "allow" | "block" } } for each rule the hold lists, as the owner answered. Send "block" for every rule when no one can be asked.

section_title.description: Title for this note — used as the filename slug (e.g. "Threads Integration")

name: update_brain
title: Update Brain
